independentReadability: docs/error-audit/readability-review.json (functional pass is not a readability score)
method: Rules applied to every selected global candidate ID. Named state corrections were inspected directly. Non-named candidates are rule-based boundary/condition review, not blanket manual copy approval.

rules.RENDER_FALLBACK: Formatting/diagram/image/URL parsing errors use an explicit unsupported/source/text fallback. These candidates are rendering/data-validation branches, not a claim that an external operation succeeded.
rules.OPTIONAL_PREFERENCE: Font-size storage failure retains the current in-memory setting; it does not block work or claim the preference was persisted.
rules.AUTOSAVE_QUEUE: Autosave retains the latest edit outside mounted views, reports failure and provides retry/flush. Promise catches keep the serial queue alive; they do not mark a failed save complete. Current save callbacks call the normalized workbench IPC.
rules.CACHE_FALLBACK: Failure to read optional local cache falls through to a fresh read; access revocation clears cached data and fresh-read failures propagate to the caller.
rules.DISPLAY_BOUNDARY: Exceptions shown by the assigned React components pass uiErrorMessage/adminErrorMessage, collaborationFailure/taskFailure or transferRecordError. Cached error strings receive the same translation at render. This rule proves the technical-detail boundary, not that every backend string was manually copyedited.
rules.UI_BUSINESS_CONDITION: Existing disabled/loading/empty state expressions are retained unless covered by a named state correction. Their conditions remain explicit source evidence; the rule does not infer clarity merely from the presence of Chinese.
rules.BACKEND_BOUNDARY: Backend exceptions and persisted error fields reach src/admin/main.ts/publicErrorState/publicFailure or the user workbench IPC mapper before presentation. Technical exceptions remain diagnostic logs; source guards and operation receipts remain authoritative.
rules.TRANSFER_RECEIPT: Transfer errors are recorded to diagnostic logs and translated with the actual phase. Awaiting receipts stay uncertain and retry queries the original receipt; file-system errors do not infer which endpoint failed. A verified receipt remains completed if subsequent local persistence fails; recovered persistence clears the warning. Missing upload cache does not prove a missing remote submission.
rules.CLIPBOARD_FEEDBACK: The original text stays visible. Copy failure uses an adjacent readable retry message and never changes to copied until IPC succeeds; technical copy exceptions are recorded by the central IPC boundary.
rules.PROJECT_REFRESH_ACCESS: The actual project refresh button is disabled while busy or disconnected; its title identifies waiting for refresh or the real top-bar central-node login entry. No empty-list claim is made by this button.
rules.BACKGROUND_STATUS: Recommendation failures stay inline as status, with an independent last-failure message or expandable reason. They do not open dialogs or block conversation.
rules.EXPECTED_FALLBACK: The catch has a specified non-fatal fallback: missing optional metadata, absent capacity support, canceled/stale work, serialization queue recovery, tray/notification fallback, or cleanup. It is not silently converted to successful business completion.
